description: Header file defining interfaces and external references for mailmap functionality in a Git-related project, including structures, constants, and function declarations for reading and processing mailmap data.

methods.name: read_mailmap_file
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a file into a string_list, with options controlled by flags.

methods.name: read_mailmap_blob
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a blob into a string_list.

methods.name: read_mailmap
methods.description: Initializes or reads the mailmap into memory.

methods.name: clear_mailmap
methods.description: Clears or resets the mailmap data.

methods.name: map_user
methods.description: Maps user email and name to their canonical forms using the mailmap.
